project_info.color_palette: KFC red, Subway green, McDonald’s red and gold, Burger King orange and navy, wet neutral gray

main_subject.detail: A 2 by 2 grid of horizontal transparent-and-colored brand capsules hovering above a wet surface, with each capsule containing a floating 3D brand icon.

items: Upper left: red KFC capsule with floating Colonel icon.
Upper right: green Subway capsule with yellow-green S arrow icon.
Lower left: McDonald’s capsule with floating gold arches.
Lower right: Burger King capsule with floating burger-logo icon.
All cells: wet condensation-covered surface, shallow warm neutral blur, sharp reflections and refractions.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Strong capsule reflections, glass refraction, wet ground highlights, soft blurred background

assets.name: official brand logo or icon
assets.usage: Place exact approved mark centered in the glass half of the capsule.

assets.name: brand color specification
assets.usage: Use on the glossy plastic capsule half.

prompt_instructions: Attach approved logo and color references.
Use only one brand identity per execution.
Retain the transparent-glass half, colored-plastic half, wet surface, and zero-gravity icon.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic, stylish poster [1080x1080] aspect ratio featuring a horizontal tablet-capsule hovering above a surface covered in condensation and water droplets, with its shadow cast on the wet ground. One side of the capsule is transparent glass, while the other is glossy [BRAND COLORS] plastic, displaying the [BRAND] logo and name. Seamlessly floating inside the glass portion of the capsule is a photorealistic 3D model of the [BRAND LOGO OR ICON], perfectly centered and suspended in zero gravity. The glass and plastic surfaces showcase strong reflections, refractions, and environmental distortions. The background is a softly blurred, elegant light-toned setting. Use a dynamic perspective with a stylish camera angle, professional studio lighting, and ultra-high detail to make the image look like a DSLR-captured photograph with impeccable realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: incorrect logo, opaque glass, missing condensation, warped capsule, crowded background, low-resolution icon, flat lighting, watermark
